popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Libya)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Libya daughter of Epaphus and Memphis — eponym of the continent, mother by Poseidon of Belus and Agenor, the stem of Egyptian and Phoenician kings.

popCulture.title: Libya
popCulture.description: The continent and modern state keep the eponym of Epaphus’ daughter — geographic language as lasting reception of the mythic ancestress.
